text:
ana: rolled prefetch-scheduler-v3 to 100% across hosted and dedicated last night. initial signals show solid latency and cost improvements — posting summary here.

ana: quick perf numbers (prod mix):
```
p50: -12% (68ms -> 60ms)
p95: -18% (310ms -> 254ms)
cost / 1M tokens: -22%
tokens/sec/GPU: +9%
```

ana: changes: dynamic prefetch heuristics, TTL-aware sliding window, improved microbatch packing, and a coalescer tweak that suppresses duplicate prefix prefetches. NOT a model change.

deploy-bot: canary (prefetch-scheduler-v3) started 2312340000, health checks green, promoted 2312343000. regions: us-west, us-east, eu-central all green. :white_check_mark:

kevin: awesome. any signal on tails? p99 / p999? multi-turn chat workloads?

ana: p99 flat within noise, p999 unchanged. interestingly, some heavy-seq customers saw p99 improvements after microbatch packing.

mike: what about KV cache churn / evictions? concerned extra prefetching could increase evicts.

ana: slot evict rate actually down ~6% — fewer redundant lookups thanks to coalescer and ttl_alpha adjustments.

liz: SLO dashboard check: error rates steady, throttles slightly reduced. no new pagers.

sarah: product: should we add a note to release notes + one-pager for AMs about expected latency/cost impact?

ana: I'll draft release note. suggested blurb: "Prefetch scheduler improvements reduce median latency and per-token cost for common workloads; no model changes required."

olivia: legal: hold external claims until we attach benchmark artifacts and reproducible configs.

ana: will upload benchmark harness, datasets, and raw traces to RT-4321 in ~30m. includes config and run logs.

james: nice work everyone :tada: Operational ask: can we consider tightening internal p95 SLA for hosted small models to <300ms?

kevin: +1 but let's observe for 2 weeks before committing. I'll monitor for regressions.

ana: next steps:
- ana: publish release note + attach artifacts to RT-4321
- kevin: 2-week watch window for regressions
- sarah + marketing: draft customer blurb (pending legal)
- liz: add prefetch hit/evict and SLO panels to runtime dashboard

ana: prod config used (for reference):
```yaml
prefetch:
  strategy: dynamic-v3
  window_ms: 40
  ttl_alpha: 0.75
  microbatch_size: 128
  coalesce_threshold: 0.6
```

mike: i'll run stress tests on heavy-seq harness today and report back.

ana: thanks all — big shoutout to runtime + infra + SRE for getting this out safely. will update when RT-4321 is live. :rocket:
